rationale: Tests recall of the primary modifiable risk factor for IHD in the Indian context covered in the Epidemiology block
Tests understanding of plaque vulnerability vs plaque size, a key concept in the pathogenesis block
Tests application of structured ACS history-taking principles — the SOCRATES mnemonic and ischaemic pain characterisation
Tests understanding of the clinical distinction between unstable angina and NSTEMI covered in the Applied Practice block
Tests application of STEMI ECG criteria — a core high-stakes skill in the ECG interpretation block
Tests understanding of high-sensitivity troponin kinetics and serial sampling covered in the biomarker block
Tests application of DAPT loading dose and antiplatelet pharmacotherapy in STEMI covered in the pharmacotherapy block
Tests understanding of the door-to-balloon time target and reperfusion window for primary PCI in STEMI
Tests application of adult BLS technique — compression rate and depth per current guidelines in the Procedure block
Tests understanding of cardiac rehabilitation evidence and mortality benefit, covered in the Cardiac Rehabilitation block
Tests application of LDL-C treatment targets for very high cardiovascular risk patients, a key decision point in the Diagnosis and Target-Setting block
Tests understanding of the statin dose-response plateau — doubling the dose gives diminishing LDL reduction, covered in the Pharmacotherapy block
